newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil lifts order blocking CRT share transfer.
newsitem.headline: Brazil lifts order blocking CRT share transfer.

text.p: A Brazilian judge lifted an injunction that blocked the transfer of a 35-percent stake in state telecom CRT, bought last week by a group including Spain's Telefonica de Espana, a state spokeswoman said.
"A judge overturned the injunction today. The sale is valid," Rio Grande do Sul state spokeswoman Neusa Froes told Reuters.

The injunction, granted to the Workers' Party (PT) on Tuesday, sought to block the transfer of Companhia Riograndense de Telecommunicacoes (CRT) shares to a group of companies that won a Dec 17 bid for the 35-percent stake in the telecom.

PT protested the sale on grounds the sale would cause the state to lose control of its majority stake in the company, Froes said. She said the judge determined that the state would maintain majority control.
In addition to Telefonica de Espana, the group includes Brazil's RBS Participacoes, Telefonica de Argentina, Chile's CTC and Citicorp.

Its 681 million real purchase of CRT shares, 54.8 percent above base price, was wathced closely by the market because it was the first opening of Brazil's massive telecommunications sector to private capital.
